Llama 2 (7B) + LoRA Adapters
Optimized Fine-Tuning (OFT):
LoRA rank-32 on LLM layers
Only LoRA params trained during RL
Preserves pre-trained features
while enabling task adaptation

div.div:
Key Difference: Optimized Fine-Tuning (OFT) Recipe
- Pre-trained backbone weights are frozen during RL
- LoRA (rank-32) adapters on LLM layers are trainable
- MLP action head: continuous L1 regression output
- Parallel decoding with action chunking (8 steps)
- No discrete tokenization (unlike base OpenVLA)
- Much fewer trainable params than full fine-tuning
SFT checkpoint: openvla-oft-sft-libero10
(pre-trained on LIBERO-10, transferred to ManiSkill via LoRA adapter)
